## Patient: Liam

**HPI:** Elderly male presenting with seropositive rheumatoid arthritis (RA) exhibiting erosive joint changes. Reports morning stiffness exceeding 1 hour, symmetric MCP joint swelling, and elevated anti-CCP levels at 250 U/mL.

**Physical Exam:**  Patient demonstrates positive morning stiffness assessment. MCP joint examination reveals symmetric swelling and tenderness.  Joint range of motion limited. Gait is slightly unsteady.

**Management Plan:** Initiate NSAID therapy as prescribed. Monitor for signs of systemic inflammation. Consider referral to rheumatologist for further evaluation and potential disease-modifying agents.  Maintain regular follow-up appointments to assess response to treatment.
